scripts.dev: npm run kill:ports && (npm run dev:pacs || echo '⚠️ PACS docker start skipped; continuing HMS dev server') && sleep 2 && npx concurrently -k -n viewer,backend,frontend -c magenta,blue,green "python3 infra/pacs/viewer_server.py --port 8080 --orthanc http://localhost:8042" "cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run kill:ports && cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run kill:ports && cd frontend && npm start
scripts.dev:pacs: echo '🏥 Starting PACS server...' && docker compose -f docker-compose.pacs.yml down --remove-orphans 2>/dev/null || true && docker compose -f docker-compose.pacs.yml up -d && sleep 5 && echo '✓ PACS services started (Orthanc: http://localhost:8042)'
scripts.dev:only: npm run kill:ports && npx concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.dev:viewer:bg: nohup python3 infra/pacs/viewer_server.py --port 8080 --orthanc http://localhost:8042 >/tmp/hms_viewer.log 2>&1 & sleep 1 && curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/ >/dev/null && echo '✓ Viewer started on http://localhost:8080'
scripts.dev:pacs:check: curl -fsS http://localhost:8042/studies >/dev/null && curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/orthanc/studies >/dev/null && curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/ >/dev/null && echo '✓ PACS check passed (Orthanc + Viewer + Proxy)'
scripts.deploy:backend:render: if [ -z "$RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL" ]; then echo "Set RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL to your Render deploy hook URL"; exit 1; fi; curl -fsS -X POST "$RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL" && echo "Render backend deploy triggered"
scripts.kill:ports: echo '🔌 Cleaning up ports 4200, 8000 and 8080...' && lsof -ti:4200,8000,8080 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true
